scope: Every original taxon/error disposition and available publisher-bound genome, every original FASTA record, sequence/case digest, base/length/N50/ambiguity and rational metrics independently reconstructed with separate Biopython parser; publisher listings/source version rechecked. GFF/CDS/annotation, flanks, contamination/haplotig/taxon identity and biology remain separate. No missing genome is excluded or considered available; no source files are rewritten.
